##### Project general facts

Kempinski Residences is a prestigious branded residential development by Kempinski Hotels, Europe’s oldest luxury hotel group with nearly 120 years of history. This exclusive property offers a unique way of living that combines the space and comforts of home with the exceptional services and amenities expected from Kempinski. Designed for discerning families, the development provides a generous array of well-thought-out living spaces, leisure, retail, and business facilities that will set new benchmarks in liveability, quality of life, and convenience. Featuring a range of layouts from suites to five-bedroom residences, all beautifully appointed with floor-to-ceiling windows, this property represents a unique investment in a remarkable history and a fine future.

Residents enjoy an exceptional collection of core leisure amenities, including a female-only gym at designated times, a landscaped pool terrace, recreation and wellness pools, a lap pool, an infinity pool, a squash court, and entertainment and sunset terraces. The development features Adventure Land kids' club with a supervised kids' pool, child-minding services, and video gaming stations, ensuring children of all ages are safe and well-catered for. Executive Members Club offers the next level of exclusivity, ideal for holding meetings and hosting guests. A la carte services include fresh flower service, butler service, personalized cleaning, child minding, shopping assistance, laundry, in-residence massage, personal trainer, private security, and doctor-on-call services.

Every residence at Kempinski Residences features three distinct interior palettes — Elegance, Chic and Glamour — each offering a unique design experience. Elegance utilizes dark timber flooring, black Marquina marble, glossy black glass mosaics, and deep greys with olive greens. Chic infuses pale and dark blues into a neutral palette of bleached oak floors and white Statuario marble. Glamour playfully combines patterns, colors, and iridescent finishes for a stylish quirkiness. Kitchens are fully equipped with high-end appliances, and the Sky Chateaux enjoy expansive panoramic views with privatized lobby, high-speed lifts, and membership to the Executive Members Club and Sky Pool.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the shores of Dubai Creek, this exceptional location is just minutes from Burj Khalifa and the heart of Downtown Dubai. Business Bay, one of the world's most prestigious precincts, offers residents a cosmopolitan centre with theatres, a new opera house, society restaurants, ultra-exclusive boutiques, cinemas, entertainment complexes, museums, and cultural experiences.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity to key destinations. Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Jumeirah Beach Road, and Al Wasl Road provide seamless access to Dubai International Airport, Dubai Mall, DIFC, World Trade Centre, Jumeirah Beaches, Burj Al Arab, Mall of the Emirates, Safa Park, Meydan, and Souk Al Bahar. The city, with all it has to offer, awaits just minutes from your front door.

For those seeking a residence that embodies legacy luxury, world-class hospitality, and a prime Dubai address, Business Bay delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of cultural richness, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can experience the finest of city living.
